diagnosis: Customer's account is in eu-central region, which does not support private networking per KB-0008. Their request remains queued and will not proceed until region support is added.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Based on our records, private networking is not yet available in your account's region (eu-central). It is available in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Requests in unsupported regions remain in a queued state rather than failing. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist who can discuss alternative options or timing.
